shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Native task dialogs over the dark backdrop.

shadows.name: accent-marker
shadows.purpose: State halo around the active demo agenda marker; not general elevation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shorten transitions and disable nonessential motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: High-priority action in restrained action red.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent-action); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-accent-action); color: var(--color-accent-ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-hover); background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Neutral, bordered action for cancel, edit, and reversible operations.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Labeled field on a raised dark surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-1); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-xs); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile navigation
components.description: Persistent four-destination bar with a visible text label and an accent-marked current page.
components.html: InicioAgendaClientes
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: grid; min-height: calc(4.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); padding: var(--space-2) max(0.5rem, env(safe-area-inset-left)) calc(var(--space-2) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-shell); } .ds-nav-link { display: grid; min-width: 0; min-height: 3.5rem; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 0.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.7rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link svg { width: 1.2rem; height: 1.2rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-link.is-active svg { color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Raised sales surface
components.description: Single working surface for the selected sales period, total, trend, and breakdown.
components.css: .ds-sales-surface { padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-sales-surface h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-lg); font-weight: 680; } .ds-sales-surface p { color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

components.name: Back link
components.description: Icon-only chevron beside the page title; the accessible name identifies the destination.
components.html: Configuración
components.css: .ds-title-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-1); } .ds-back { display: inline-grid; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; place-items: center; margin-inline-start: -0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-back svg { width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-back:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Custom dropdown
components.description: Keyboard-operable listbox with explicit selected and active states.
components.html: • Todos
components.css: .ds-dropdown { position: relative; } .ds-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; } .ds-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: calc(100% + 0.4rem) 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface-raised); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); list-style: none; } .ds-option { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-ink-muted); } .ds-option.is-selected { background: var(--color-accent-action); color: var(--color-accent-ink); }

components.name: Mobile month calendar
components.description: Monday-first Spanish calendar with a selected day and appointment markers.
components.html: LMXJVSD
components.css: .ds-calendar { display: grid; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-weekdays, .ds-days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.25rem; text-align: center; } .ds-day { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; } .ds-day.is-selected { border-color: var(--color-accent-action); background: var(--color-accent-action); color: var(--color-accent-ink); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Semantic status pill
components.description: Compact status text paired with semantic color; the wording carries the meaning.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 1.5rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 14%, var(--color-surface)); color: var(--color-success); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Native task dialog
components.description: Focused create/edit task surface with a dark backdrop and visible close/cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: min(48rem, calc(100% - 2rem)); max-width: 48rem; max-height: min(90dvh, 56rem); margin: auto; padding: 0; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%); } .ds-modal::backdrop { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 72%); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); }

narrative.overview: The system treats the barber shop's working day as the product's organizing rhythm. Administrators should find the next appointment, understand the selected sales period, and move between business areas without learning a new interaction language. The interface is an Operate surface: familiar navigation and controls come first, with a restrained charcoal field, deliberate red actions, compact numeric typography, and a readable appointment timeline.
keyCharacteristics: Deep charcoal surfaces with neutral, high-contrast text.
Red is reserved for primary actions, active navigation, and meaningful emphasis.
Numeric and time values use tabular data typography.
Mobile uses a persistent four-destination bottom navigation; desktop uses a side rail.
Demonstration status and simulated behavior remain explicit.

rules.name: The Red Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use red for action, selection, or meaningful emphasis; do not spread it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Demo Is Visible Rule
rules.body: Any synthetic record, amount, or simulated action remains labeled as demonstration content.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Money and time values use tabular numerals and stay attached to explicit labels and units.

dos: Do label every synthetic metric and simulated action.
Do keep a text label for each appointment status.
Do keep mobile navigation outside the scrollable work area.
Do keep chart labels and appointment details readable at phone widths.
donts: Don't imply login, persistence, notifications, or sales are real server operations.
Don't represent the illustrative dollar symbol as a confirmed currency.
Don't use red as passive decoration or rely on color as the only status indicator.
Don't add decorative gradients, glass effects, icon-only navigation, or identical dashboard cards.
